en-US: Build 208 internal device test includes the Office, IDE document tabs, Git initialization, native mind map and Shell repairs from build 207. Please also test: asking one task to read another task, including long history and continuing after interruption; local-model tool calls followed by a visible final answer, context compression and recovery; the separate Linux, Python, Node and WASM package entries. Linux environments now have shared Shell/local Python/service routing and a common Python package environment. The TinyEMU backend is integrated, but no qualified Linux download image is offered yet: APT HTTPS compatibility and the image source record remain unresolved. Native and WASM execution remain available. This delivery uses focused code checks and a cloud App build; physical-device behavior is for your manual acceptance. Office recovery copies are retained, but a failed document-engine process can still require restarting the App.
zh-Hans: Build 208 内部真机测试，包含 207 的 Office、IDE 文档内部标签、Git 初始化、原生思维导图和 Shell 修复。请额外测：让一个任务读取另一个任务的内容，包含长历史和中断后继续；本地模型调用工具后的最终答复、上下文压缩及失败恢复；Linux、Python、Node、WASM 各自的安装入口。Linux 环境的 Shell、local Python 和后台服务已接入同一后端，共用 Python 包环境。TinyEMU 后端代码已集成，但尚未提供通过验证的 Linux 下载镜像：APT HTTPS 兼容性及镜像源码记录仍待解决。原生和 WASM 路径继续可用。本轮采用定向代码检查与云端 App 构建，真机行为由你手动验收。Office 恢复副本会保留，但文档引擎进程真正失败后仍可能需要重启 App。
